product.description: Monoprice™Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket for 23" to 60" TVs up to 77lbs, Max VESA 400x400The Monoprice Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket is specially designed to accommodate TVs and monitors spanning 23 to 60 inches. With a sturdy weight capacity of 77 pounds, it's an excellent choice for small-to-medium displays. Unlike traditional fixed or tilt mounts that cater to a single viewing angle, this full-motion mount is ideal for spacious rooms with multiple viewing zones.Crafted to fit snugly on a single stud, our solid mount optimizes space utilization while supporting up to 77 pounds. Its compact footprint is ideal for computer monitors and small televisions, yet it easily accommodates mid-range screens up to 60 inches in size. When flush against the wall, the mount positions itself just 2.1 inches away, ensuring an unobtrusive appearance. With a full-motion extension capability spanning up to 16.7 inches, you can effortlessly adjust the TV angle to suit different viewing areas—whether directing towards a kitchen table or minimizing glare from nearby windows.Beyond its full articulation capabilities, the Monoprice Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket offers an impressive 180-degree swivel range. You can also tilt the screen upward or downward for optimal viewing comfort, and the level rotation ensures your display remains perfectly horizontal. Whether you're relaxing on the couch, sitting on the floor, or standing in the kitchen, this wall mount provides the flexibility you need.To secure compatibility with a wide range of televisions and computer monitors, the Monoprice Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket supports VESA mounting patterns from 75 x 75 up to 400 x 400. This wide range covers the majority of modern displays for television and computer use. As a bonus, it comes with all the necessary mounting hardware, so you won't need to make any unnecessary trips to the local hardware store.In a nutshell, the Monoprice Full Motion Single-Stud TV Wall Mount Bracket offers impressive flexibility for small and average-sized TVs and monitors ranging from 23 to 60 inches. Its sleek design, full-motion extension range, swivel capabilities, and compatibility with various TV models make it a dependable choice for creating the perfect viewing experience in any room.
